description: Read a Bible passage in one or more editions side by side (Hebrew WLC, Greek Septuagint, SBL Greek NT, English WEB/King James/ASV/Douay-Rheims/Brenton, Russian Synodal, Luther 1912, Louis Segond). Reference numbering is WEB, or WEB Classic for additional books it holds, otherwise Brenton. source_numbering identifies native verses. Unestablished correspondences are flagged aligned:false with no counterpart text.

editions.description: Edition ids from list_editions, e.g. ["hebrew","lxx","en"]. Defaults to the reference edition: en, web-full or lxx-en for that book.

name: get_passage
